description: A macOS menu bar app that puts a procedurally drawn skateboarder on your desktop. The skater rolls along the top edges of your real windows (read via CGWindowListCopyWindowInfo, no permissions), rides windows you drag, gets launched when you flick one, and falls when you pull one away. Two modes: an autonomous skater that cruises, ollies, flips and grinds on its own, and a keyboard mode where the overlay takes focus and you drive. ⌃⌥S or the menu toggles between them, and Esc hands focus back. You can drop quarter pipes, kickers, rails and boxes on the desktop from the menu and drag them around; the skater uses them.
notInThisRun: Score/combo system and trick names on screen
Resizing obstacles by dragging their edges

userStories.title: Surface builder and obstacle geometry
userStories.description: Turn windows, screens and obstacles into collision segments: visible top edges of windows after occlusion, screen floors and outer walls, and the shapes of each obstacle kind.
acceptanceCriteria: Each window's top edge becomes one-way grindable .ledge segments, minus the spans covered by windows in front of it (lower zIndex)
Each screen's visible-frame bottom becomes a two-way .ground surface; outer screen sides with no neighbouring screen become .wall surfaces
Surfaces carry ownerID and ownerVelocity; teleported windows report zero velocity
Tiny windows (<60pt wide or <40pt tall) and slivers of ledge shorter than 24pt are dropped

ObstacleGeometry.profile returns local polylines: quarter pipe = flat deck + curved transition (≥10 segments) up to near-vertical lip; kicker = straight incline; rail = flat grindable top bar; box = flat grindable top with angled ends
ObstacleGeometry.surfaces returns those as global surfaces with chained endpoints, mirrored when flipped
swift build passes

userStories.title: Skater physics
userStories.description: Rolling along surfaces (slopes, curved ramps, carried by moving windows), ollies, air, landing, flip tricks, grinds, bails, respawn.
acceptanceCriteria: Rolling follows the surface tangent, continues across chained segments, and leaves the surface at the end of a segment or past vertical on a ramp
A skater on a moving surface moves with it; leaving it keeps the surface velocity (flick a window up → launched)
If the surface under the skater disappears (window closed, dragged away), the skater falls
Ollie: hold jump to crouch, release to pop along the surface normal
Landing uses a swept test against one-way surfaces from the normal side; landing with a trick under 1.0 progress or a large board/surface angle is a bail
Grind: landing on a grindable surface while holding grind locks into .grinding with low friction
Bail lasts ~1.2s then the skater gets up; falling far below every screen respawns near the top
Events emitted: ollie, landed, grindStart/End, bail, trickStarted, respawned
swift build passes

userStories.title: Window tracker
userStories.description: Poll CGWindowListCopyWindowInfo, convert to AppKit coordinates, track per-window velocity, detect teleports.
acceptanceCriteria: Only layer-0, on-screen, non-transparent windows from other processes, ordered front to back (zIndex 0 = front)
Top-left → bottom-left coordinate flip uses the primary screen height
Velocity is smoothed across polls; a jump >400pt in one poll or a resize-heavy jump is flagged teleported with zero velocity
No permissions required (does not read window titles)
swift build passes

userStories.title: Procedural skater renderer
userStories.description: Draw a stick-figure skater and board from SkaterState with poses for every phase, plus particle effects.
acceptanceCriteria: Board with deck, kicktails and wheels, rotated to state.angle; figure stands on it facing state.facing
Poses: push/cruise, crouch (state.crouch), air tuck, each TrickKind rotates/flips the board, grind stance, bail (figure tumbles off, board separate)
Readable on both light and dark windows (dark figure with a light outline)
Effects: grind sparks, landing dust, bail stars
swift build passes

userStories.title: Overlay windows and game loop
userStories.description: One transparent click-through panel per screen, a display-linked frame loop that polls windows, builds the world, steps physics and draws. Keyboard input when in keyboard mode.
acceptanceCriteria: Panels: borderless, clear, ignoresMouseEvents, level above obstacles, join all Spaces and fullscreen; rebuilt when screens change
Fixed-timestep physics at 120Hz, rendering at display rate, window poll ~30Hz
Keyboard mode: overlay panel becomes key and reads ←/→ (A/D) roll, Space hold/release ollie, ↑/F trick, ↓/S grind, R respawn
Debug: AppState.showSurfaces draws all surfaces
Hidden/paused respected
swift build passes

userStories.title: Autopilot
userStories.description: An autonomous skater that cruises, turns at walls and window ends, ollies onto higher ledges, does tricks off ramps, grinds rails.
acceptanceCriteria: Keeps moving, turns around at walls and occasionally at random
Looks ahead for ledges it can reach and ollies up to them; drops off ends or ollies off them
Throws a trick when air time allows, grinds grindable surfaces sometimes
Gets back up after bails without getting stuck; idles briefly sometimes
swift build passes

userStories.title: Draggable obstacles
userStories.description: Each obstacle is a small panel you drag around the desktop; persisted between launches.
acceptanceCriteria: Panel draws the obstacle from ObstacleGeometry.profile (filled, light/dark readable), draggable anywhere on its body
Right-click menu: Flip, Remove
Velocity measured while dragging so the skater can be launched by a moving ramp
Positions saved to UserDefaults and restored; restored off-screen obstacles are pulled back on screen
swift build passes

userStories.title: Menu bar, hotkeys, mode switching
userStories.description: Status item menu and global hotkeys to switch modes, add obstacles, hide, respawn; focus handoff for keyboard mode.
acceptanceCriteria: Menu: Autonomous / Keyboard (checkmarked), Add ▸ each obstacle kind, Remove All Obstacles, Respawn Skater, Hide, Show Surfaces, Controls help item, Quit
⌃⌥S toggles mode, ⌃⌥H hides/shows (Carbon RegisterEventHotKey, no permissions)
Entering keyboard mode remembers the frontmost app and activates DeskSkate; Esc or ⌃⌥S returns to autonomous and reactivates that app; switching away to another app falls back to autonomous

userStories.title: Headless physics scenarios
userStories.description: swift run simcheck runs scripted scenarios against the core and prints pass/fail.
acceptanceCriteria: Scenarios: drop onto a window ledge and settle; roll off a ledge end and land on a lower one; ride a window moving sideways; window flicked upward launches skater; window removed → falls to ground; quarter pipe sends skater up and back; grind a rail; autopilot runs 60s without getting stuck or leaving the screen
Exit code non-zero on any failure
